title: Superspace group notation
action: Given the basic structure of NbS3-I (space group P2_1/m, a=9.14 Å, b=4.96 Å, c=6.73 Å, γ=97.2°, Z=2, 2e positions) and the experimental constraints for NbS3-II (basic modulation cell G_B with parameters a, b, c, γ; modulation wavevector q ≈ 0.352c*; observed extinctions: main reflections vanish unless h even, first-order satellites vanish unless h odd in a 2a×b×c cell; indexing cells G_M1(2a,4b,c/0.352,γ=97°) and G_M2(2a,4b,2c/0.352,γ=97°)), derive the superspace group for incommensurately modulated NbS3-II in dualistic notation. Use the basic cell symmetry P2_1/m with approximate enlarged cell a≈9.1 Å, b≈4×4.96=19.9 Å, c≈3.4 Å, γ≈97°, and the requirement of B centering with a phase shift π between intra-layer modulation columns.
description: A plain text file containing the superspace group in dualistic notation exactly as derived.
output_schema: Single line string, e.g. 'A P2_1/m (1,-1)' or the full dualistic equivalent including the mP2_1/m and cB2/m expansions.

title: Extinction rules
action: From the superspace group determined in step_01, compute the systematic extinction conditions for main reflections (hkl) and first-order satellite reflections (hkl±q). Express the conditions in terms of the reflection indices (h, k, l) and the satellite order m.
description: CSV file listing the extinction rules for main and satellite reflections.
output_schema: Columns: reflection (string: 'main' or 'satellite'), condition (string: e.g. 'h even', 'h odd'), description (string: brief explanation).

title: Modulation cell parameters
action: Based on the superspace group notation and the given indexing cells G_M1 and G_M2, state the basic modulation cell and the full incommensurate modulation cell for NbS3-II. The basic cell uses the enlarged basic-cell parameters (a, 4b, c) and the incommensurate cell uses the B-centered enlargement (2a, 4b, 2.84c).
description: Text file listing the two modulation cells and their parameters.
output_schema: Line 1: 'basic modulation cell: a=9.1, b=19.9, c=3.4, gamma=97 degrees' (approximate). Line 2: 'incommensurate modulation cell: a=18.2, b=19.9, c=9.66, gamma=97 degrees, B-centered' (derived from G_M1).
